get.summary: Pull what changed for the signed-in person since the last pull
get.description: Returns, per synchronized table, the rows created, updated and deleted since `last_pulled_at` (epoch milliseconds; absent for a first pull), limited to what the caller may see. Order, order line and delivery rows follow the role of the caller: supplier view for owners, managers and sellers, a narrower view for drivers, the customer view for customers. The header `X-Scope-Version` is the rights version the phone knows: when it is lower than the person's and `last_pulled_at` is set, the answer is `{ resync_required: true }` without changes and the phone starts again with a full pull. A full pull records the version on the device. Every pull sets the device `last_synced_at`.

schema.description: Epoch milliseconds of the previous pull
The rights version the phone knows; absent counts as 0

200.description: The changes per table and the timestamp to send as the next `last_pulled_at`
